author: bardic-inspiration
name: The Repository
summary: The archive under the Library: a gate, then nine vaults that each keep one part of the Library's organizing system.
description: The stair opens onto vaults older than the building above them. Each one hums with its own machinery, and each one keeps a different part of how the Library knows what it holds.

zones.name: Validation Gate
zones.note: The way in: an iron gate that reads everything carried through it and rings when something does not fit.

zones.name: Content Stacks
zones.note: Endless aisles of entries in their folders, filed by ruleset, then by type, then by name.

zones.name: Schema Forge
zones.note: Racks of iron molds, one for every kind of entry, and an anvil where new entries are pressed into shape.

zones.name: Registry Vault
zones.note: A strongroom of ledgers that list every kind of entry the Library may hold, beside a sealed scroll of forbidden words.

zones.name: Ruleset Engine
zones.note: A clockwork of brass gears that reckons every derived number: Hit Points, Armor Class, saves, and challenge.

zones.name: Wording Loom
zones.note: A great loom that weaves each page's composed text from threads of phrase, one thread for every mark of punctuation.

zones.name: Diagram Gallery
zones.note: A gallery of maps drawn in bare lines on slate, each zone outlined and labeled.

zones.name: Index Hall
zones.note: A domed hall around a single enormous catalogue that names every entry and every link between them.

zones.name: Test Chambers
zones.note: Small proving rooms where entries are tried against what they claim to be.

zones.name: Press Hall
zones.note: The presses that print every page the Library shows, and the last stop before anything reaches the shelves above.
